callout_text: Downgraded finding: the within-category recurring-feature pattern found for bfs and topological_sort (both 100% recurrence) does NOT generalize to dag_shortest_paths or mst_prim (50% and 67% recurrence, below the 80% threshold), the two other CLEAN-class algorithms tested for this specific mechanism. bfs and topological_sort should be treated as isolated cases showing a specific recurring-feature pattern, not evidence of a general within-category-redundancy mechanism across CLEAN algorithms.
